254-material census; thick bars IQR, thin bars P05-P95; denominators are comparable systems
D | The gain persists across the full Hartree contract ladder
Primary Hartree contract: relative RMSE < 10⁻⁶. Confirmatory cohort: 48/48 wins; median CR ratio 15.016× (bootstrap 95% CI 11.204–21.461); 48/48 Nyquist-safe guardrails passed.
Full census at 10⁻⁶: 253/253 comparable wins; median 12.463×; P05 4.459×; minimum 2.444×. Eligibility and baseline availability define the denominator at each tolerance.
QOAC-H allocates reciprocal-space error from the Hartree operator and verifies the allocation against an operator-blind ablation.
The frozen design is then tested on a disjoint cohort and the complete development population.
